'''Suspensas''' were [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Clothing/Legends|fashion accessories]] that consisted of a dangling ornament, such as [[Gold/Legends|gold]]-colored [[Orichalc/Legends|orichalc]] chains, strings of white [[Veda pearl/Legends|veda pearls]] and [[Glass/Legends|glass]] filaments, or [[Color/Legends|black]] beads.<ref name="Episode I VD" /> When the [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], she wore them with multiple [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|royal]] garments.<ref name="Episode I" /> Her [[Shiraya fan headdress/Legends|Shiraya fan headdress]] had clusters of [[Glass/Legends|glass]] filaments in a "veil of tears" that suggested her profound sadness.<ref name="FF 29">{{FactFile2014|29|GAR 1-4|Naboo Royal Garments}}</ref> Many of her suspensa ornaments came from the treasure rooms in [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]].<ref name="Episode I VD" />

At the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when Amidala was the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], she wore a pair of heirloom suspensas on her [[Ear/Legends|earlobes]]<ref name="RotS VD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> when she told her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], that she was [[Reproduction/Legends|pregnant]].<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref>

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Suspensas first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="Episode I" /> They were first identified in the 1999 reference book [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']], which was written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]].<ref name="TPMVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
